name: The Watch Wire (@watchwireco)
audience: Luxury watch enthusiasts and collectors who follow brands, releases, auctions, prices and celebrity watches

visual.direction: Black-and-champagne luxury news in two templates: A (News) photo fading into jet with champagne tag and uppercase Oswald headline; D (Story) full-bleed dark photo, WW monogram, centred Poppins title-case headline. Never mix A and D in one carousel; shared closing slide; 8pt grid, 48px margins.
colors: Champagne #C8A96A signal only (one moment per slide)
typography: Oswald 700 uppercase: news headlines, tags, wordmark
Poppins 700/600 title case: story headlines and sentences
Playfair Display 600: WW monogram, story wordmark, 'or'
imagery: Credited brand press, auction-house and event press photos, plus own photos
Credit line 'Image: [source]' on every photo slide; press photos registered as permission-needed
Avoid other creators' screenshots, watermarked images, edited watches, stock photos
visual.logo_usage: Text-only. Wordmark THE WATCH WIRE in Oswald 700 uppercase with WIRE in champagne, top-left on news slides (min 18px, else @WATCHWIRECO). WW monogram in Playfair Display top-centre on story slides and as profile icon. Serif ivory wordmark bottom-centre on story slides.

do: Name the source for every number and date every price
Sources and dates go in the caption and slide footer, never in slide text; one named source is enough
Plain words: each slide one normal sentence a non-expert gets; no reference numbers or codes on slides
Say 'spotted wearing' unless ownership is confirmed; state whether auction prices include fees
avoid: Clickbait the slides don't pay off; emojis in headlines
Reposting other creators' slides or photos
Presenting press photos as our own

cta_style: Calm and direct, one action: 'Vote in the comments.' 'Swipe for the full list.' 'Follow @watchwireco for daily watch news.'
